description: Use this when someone wants to find a date or time that works for a group (a dinner, meeting, call, game night, class). Publishes a shared web page where people answer yes, if need be or no for each proposed time. Returns a public link to share and a private organizer link. Takes 2-30 options as date + start time in one IANA time zone; refuses times that do not exist because of a daylight-saving change. Does not send invitations, emails or reminders. Do not use for a single fixed event that needs no vote.

allow_if_need_be.description: Offer an 'if need be' answer besides yes and no, e.g. true. Default true.

duration_minutes.description: Default length of each option in minutes (5-1440), e.g. 120. Default 60.

hide_names.description: true to show only counts publicly, so only the organizer sees who answered what, e.g. false. Default false.

location.description: Place or call details in words, e.g. Luigi's, Main Street. No links.

note.description: Short note shown on the page, e.g. We will book a table for whoever can come.

organizer_name.description: Organizer's first name shown on the page, e.g. Sam.

date.description: Day of this option as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-14.

duration_minutes.description: Length of this option in minutes if it differs from the poll default, e.g. 90.

start.description: Local start time in the poll's time zone, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 18:30.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the proposed times, e.g. Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.

title.description: What the group is meeting for, e.g. Team dinner.
